description: Baseline measurement with original card text
Patched card suggestion text with richer, more specific descriptions including file names, commit subjects, and actionable advice. Both eval hit rates hit 100%.

Patched negative example generation: 6 varied answer templates instead of 1, 8 prompt templates instead of 5, 2 more unknown files. Added extra QA templates for repeated-fix and test-gap. Reduced total negatives from 37 to 31 while increasing diversity.
Trained LoRA adapter with 50 iters. Val loss: 4.317 → 1.338 (69% reduction). Model: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct, 4 LoRA layers, lr=1e-5, batch=4.
LoRA training with 8 layers, 200 iters, lr=5e-5. Val loss: 4.317 → 0.251 (best at iter 180). Training converged by iter 100, minimal improvement after. 2.6M trainable params (0.171% of 1.5B).

Qualitative evaluation of trained adapter. 5/7 responses accurate. Known issue: hallucinates on unknown files (classifies as repeated-fix instead of negative). Chat template format critical for quality.

Added config-file negatives (tsconfig, .gitignore, LICENSE), improved low-confidence negative answers. Retrained with 8 LoRA layers, 200 iters, lr=5e-5. Val loss best: 0.125 (97% reduction from baseline 4.317).
Improved model: 7/10 correct responses. src/new-feature.ts now correctly identifies as no-risk. LICENSE and unknown-file.ts still hallucinate. Risk classification JSON works correctly.
